_comment: Pinned CI-built web bundle for the deployment flake. The release workflow (.github/workflows/release.yml) builds eza-web-<version>.tar.gz on a v* tag, uploads it to the GitHub release and rewrites the hash below with the asset's SRI sha256. To pin by hand: bash scripts/release-asset.sh --out dist/release (prints the SRI hash), copy it over the placeholder, then run bash scripts/release-asset.sh --check --require-pinned. Keep url in step with flake.nix version and the repository name; checks.eza-web-pin fails while the hash is the lib.fakeHash placeholder.
